name: triage-bug-report
description: Triage a bug report with an LLM: assign a P0–P3 priority + rationale, then format a triage summary. Pass the report as process inputs (no interactive form).

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## Triage Summary\n" +
  "**Title:** " + ((.title // "(untitled)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Reporter:** " + ((.reporter // "unknown") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Severity (self-reported):** " + ((.severity // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Priority (triaged):** " + ((."assess-priority".priority // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Rationale:** " + ((."assess-priority".rationale // "?") | tostring) +
  (if ((.component // "") | tostring) != "" then "\n**Component:** " + ((.component // "") | tostring) else "" end)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{triage_summary: .}'
